hints.title: Segment Precomputation per Row and Column
hints.text: Enemies hit by a bomb extend horizontally and vertically until blocked by a wall or grid border.

hints.title: Reusing Line Hits Between Obstacles
hints.text: Row hits only need to be recomputed when starting a new row or moving past a wall. Column hits are cached per column until a wall resets them.

hints.title: Two-Dimensional Scanning with Hit Buffers
hints.text: Maintain row_hits and an array col_hits of size cols. Scan row by row. At each cell, recalculate row_hits if at row start or wall. Recalculate col_hits[c] if at col start or wall. If cell is 0, update max result.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal dynamic programming solution running in linear O(M * N) time with O(N) auxiliary column buffer.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning 4 rays for every empty cell takes O(M * N * (M + N)) cubic operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching row and column segment hits amortizes scanning to exactly once per obstacle segment.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should only deploy bombs on empty cells ("0") and stop rays at walls ("W").
